title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability in Task Creation
description: The task creation input field executes arbitrary HTML and JavaScript injected via task input, as demonstrated by the execution of a script trigger alert dialog.
steps_to_reproduce: Type '' into the 'New task' input field.
evidence: Experiment log round 1 shows a dialog '1' and console error resulting from resource loading when submitting the HTML/JS payload.

title: Broken Link for Pricing Navigation
description: The 'Pricing' navigation link points to '/pricing', which returns a 404 Not Found error.
steps_to_reproduce: Click on the 'Pricing' link in the top navigation menu.

title: Uncaught ReferenceError in Console ('trackPageView')
description: A JavaScript reference error occurs on the page due to an undefined 'trackPageView' function call.
steps_to_reproduce: Load the page and check the browser developer console.
evidence: Static evidence console_errors contains 'trackPageView is not defined'.

title: Layout Overflow on Extremely Long Task Descriptions
description: Entering extremely long task strings causes horizontal overflow on the page layout.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter a very long text string into the 'New task' field.
evidence: Experiment log round 2 indicates 'horizontal_overflow: true' after adding a long task.

title: Missing Image Alternative Text
description: Images on the page lack alternate text, failing accessibility standards.
steps_to_reproduce: Run an accessibility audit (such as axe) against the page.
evidence: Static evidence a11y audit lists rule 'image-alt' with critical impact and count 1.

title: Insufficient Color Contrast
description: Certain text elements do not meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
steps_to_reproduce: Run an accessibility audit against the page colors.
evidence: Static evidence a11y audit lists rule 'color-contrast' with serious impact.

title: Missing Main Landmark
description: The document lacks a main landmark container for accessibility.
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect the HTML structure for a <main> landmark.
evidence: Static evidence a11y audit lists rule 'landmark-one-main' with moderate impact.

title: Form Inputs Lacking Accessible Labels
description: Several interactive input elements and buttons are missing explicit accessible labels or aria-labels.
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect elements such as the email input, buttons, and sign up links using an accessibility inspector.
evidence: Static evidence element list indicates 'labelled: false' for multiple interactive elements.
